name: Hostek Karlskrona data center
notes: Hostek lists a Tier 3 data center in Karlskrona in southeast Sweden; Data Center Map lists the facility at Ronnebygatan 36, Karlskrona.

name: Affarsverken Galgamarken-Trosso data center
notes: Facility database lists an Affarsverken-operated carrier-neutral data center at 53 Norra Smedjegatan, Karlskrona, with 1.4 MW power capacity.

name: Microsoft Staffanstorp datacenter
notes: Microsoft states it operates datacenters in Gavle, Sandviken, and Staffanstorp; the Swedish cloud region includes Staffanstorp in Skane/Scania.

name: Bahnhof Sparven / Tranquility Base Malmo
notes: Bahnhof lists Sparven at Storgatan 15B, Malmo, as its southernmost data center; 2019 announcement describes an additional server hall at the site.

name: GleSYS Falkenberg data center
notes: GleSYS official facility page lists Falkenberg as a mission-critical colocation/cloud/GPU facility with 10 MW high power capacity and 100 percent renewable electricity.

name: Bahnhof Bunker / Bunkerberget Gothenburg
notes: Bahnhof announced a new data center in Bunkerberget near central Gothenburg; the underground facility is about 6,000 sqm and is described on Bahnhof's colocation page as upcoming.

name: atNorth Gothenburg SWE03 / former Gompute data center
notes: atNorth announced acquisition of Gompute and its Gothenburg data center, with capacity potential of 10 MW, for HPC and AI workloads.

name: Beebyte Karlstad data centers
notes: Beebyte states it currently has three data centers in Karlstad, Varmland: Datacenter 02, Datacenter 03, and Datacenter 04.

name: Proact SG2 Orebro data center
notes: Facility databases list Proact SG2 at 2 Stubbengatan, Orebro, as an operational colocation data center; Inflect reports 1.5 MW power capacity.

name: Proact EV8 Orebro data center
notes: Inflect lists a Proact-operated data center at 8 Elementvagen, Orebro, with 600 kW power; Proact's official office page confirms the Elementvagen 8 Orebro presence.

name: AWS Europe (Stockholm) Region - Vasteras data center
notes: AWS launched the Europe (Stockholm) Region in 2018; Business Sweden says the three Swedish data centers opened in Eskilstuna, Vasteras, and Katrineholm.

name: AWS Malardalen expansion - Vasteras data centre
notes: About Amazon says AWS is building new data centres in Eskilstuna, Katrineholm, and Vasteras for the Europe (Stockholm) Region, with main buildings due for completion by mid-2025.

name: EcoDataCenter 1 Falun
notes: EcoDataCenter official page lists EcoDataCenter 1 in Falun as a large-scale AI/HPC site with 80 MW total available power and 100 percent renewable electricity.

name: EcoDataCenter 2 Borlange
notes: EcoDataCenter official page lists the Borlange site as up to 600 MW with construction start in 2025 and first phase due mid-2027; trade press reported the 2025 groundbreaking.

name: Microsoft Gavle and Sandviken datacenters
notes: Microsoft states it operates datacenters in Gavle and Sandviken; Microsoft News says the Sweden datacenter region includes a presence in Gavle and Sandviken.

name: Microsoft new facilities in Gavle and Sandviken
notes: Microsoft's Sweden datacenter PDF says Microsoft operates datacenters in Gavle, Sandviken, and Staffanstorp and is also building new facilities in Gavle and Sandviken.

name: atNorth SWE04 Solleftea mega site
notes: atNorth official pages list SWE04 in Solleftea, Vasternorrland, as a 50-hectare 300 MW mega site at Hamre Industrial Park; announcement says the site is fully zoned and prepared for development.

name: Verda Sundsvall AI infrastructure hub
notes: Verda announced a next-generation AI infrastructure hub in Sundsvall, Vasternorrland, intended to support high-performance compute capacity and sustainable AI infrastructure; capacity not disclosed.
